A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 23-page versions of the same survey. Text comparison and visual inspection support reliable comparison of the main text, tables, figures, equations, references, and Appendices A–G.

before.justification: v2 presents a conceptual literature survey without original empirical results. Appendix A's screening counts of 1,007 papers narrowed to 147 document literature selection; the tables and illustrations synthesize prior work.

after.justification: v3 retains the same conceptual survey and literature-selection counts. Neither its main text nor Appendices A–G reports original experimental, simulation, user-study, or empirical data-analysis results.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the identical taxonomy and descriptions of sequential, triage-based, and joint cooperation. No algorithm, model component, or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Neither version conducts original training or evaluation on datasets or tasks. The surveyed applications, including data annotation and information seeking in Appendix G, are unchanged.

E2.justification: The surveyed methods and Table 2's comparison of related surveys are identical. Neither version reports an empirical baseline comparison.

E3.justification: No empirical evaluation protocol is added or revised. Appendix A retains the same literature-search and screening procedures.

E4.justification: Neither version reports original ablations, sensitivity analyses, or robustness experiments. The illustrative applications in Appendix G are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated runs, confidence intervals, or significance tests for original results. Section 4.1's conceptual discussion of human uncertainty estimation is unchanged.

E6.justification: The findings attributed to prior studies and all table and figure content are unchanged. Appendix A retains the same 1,007-paper initial collection and 147-paper selected corpus; no empirical results are added.

T1.justification: Appendix C retains identical participant, action, constraint, and policy definitions and the same shared-utility optimization formulation. No mathematical reasoning or formal assumptions change.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: a survey of cooperation principles and formalizations, a unified taxonomy, and identification of research frontiers.

C2.justification: The interpretations, technical challenges, and social implications are unchanged. The limitations concerning multi-party cooperation, collaboration, and non-cooperation are also retained verbatim.

D1.justification: Appendix A's search keywords and inclusion/exclusion information are unchanged, as are resource links. No implementation, hardware, hyperparameter, or reproducibility information is added or revised.

R1.justification: The reference list, citations, Table 2, and Appendix B's positioning against earlier surveys are unchanged. Reference pagination shifts do not change cited-work membership.

P1.justification: Acknowledgments add grants U24A20328 and 2024YFHZ0233 and replace Singapore MOE grant MSS24C004 with MSS24C012. The arXiv version/date stamp changes; scholarly prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded acknowledgments cause limited text reflow through the references and early appendices on PDF pages 9–19. All eight figures and both tables retain their designs, captions, and placement.

improvement.justification: v3 updates funding attribution and produces incidental layout shifts. The survey's scientific content, formalization, references, explanations, and limitations remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices, leaving overall scholarly quality effectively unchanged.
